title: From a Gap in the Lyapunov Spectrum to Dominated Splittings
summary: Let $A$ be an $α$-Hölder cocycle over a transitive two-sided subshift of finite type, and assume that $A$ is strongly bunched. We prove that if there exist $k\in\{1,\ldots,d-1\}$ and $c>0$ such that \[ λ_k(p)-λ_{k+1}(p)\ge c \] for every periodic point $p$, then $A$ admits a dominated splitting of index $k$. Thus, under strong bunching, a uniform asymptotic gap in the Lyapunov spectrum of periodic measures implies a uniform geometric splitting along all orbit segments.
